resources.string: See the outfit on you before you buy
Add your photo and a product link or garment image. ALMI_AI combines them into a realistic try-on image, then can animate the result.
Use a clear photo that shows your body and current pose.
Paste a product link or upload the garment image directly.
This store page could not be read. Upload the garment image instead.
The product page was found, but no usable image was detected. Upload the garment image instead.
Nothing is uploaded until you start generation.
AI is not configured. Open AI settings and activate a valid mode.
Free mode needs an OpenRouter API key for authentication, even when the selected model itself is free.
No free image-generation model compatible with try-on is currently available. Refresh the free catalog later or activate a custom model.
The AI could not create the image. Check your connection, provider settings, balance or limits, and reference images, then try again.
This is a high-realism visual simulation. A single photo cannot guarantee physical garment measurements or fit to the millimeter.
Video generation failed. Your try-on image is still saved; you can retry the video.
Selected photos stay on your device until you press the AI generation button. At that point the required references are sent to the active provider for generation.
The entire interface and layout direction follow this choice.
Choose a clean light or dark theme, or follow the device.
Choose one active AI mode: your custom model or automatic free-model routing.
Enter your provider, endpoint, API key, image model and video model manually.
The custom service must accept the same media request/response contract used by OpenRouter-style image and asynchronous video APIs. Technical IDs and URLs are kept exactly as entered.
Custom model saved and activated. Free mode is now off.
Automatically discovers compatible free media models and tries them in priority order.
While free mode is on, it is the only active AI route in ALMI_AI. The saved custom model is not used until free mode is turned off.
OpenRouter API key for free mode
OpenRouter still requires an account API key for authentication. Free models do not charge model usage, but they can have rate and daily limits.
There is currently no explicitly free OpenRouter image-generation model that accepts image references. ALMI_AI will detect one automatically if the catalog changes.
No compatible free video model was found in the current catalog.
Could not refresh the free-model catalog. Check your connection and try again.

ALMI_AI can keep up to 30 compatible free candidates for each media type. It tries the highest-priority candidate first and automatically moves to the next after a provider/model failure. The actual count depends on what is genuinely free and compatible at that moment.
ALMI_AI has its own Android identity and can be installed beside VibeApp.
Install a newer ALMI_AI APK over the current version; you do not need to uninstall first when the update comes from the same signing channel.
